feeds.title: The Capital City Bourbon Blog
feeds.description: I'm Luke. This is a very simple blog. The reality is that I absolutely love bourbon and whiskey in general. And I love talking about these spirits almost as much as I love drinking them, so a blog seemed like the next logical step.I intend on sharing tasting notes, reviews, recommendations, and various other topics related to bourbon.

feeds.title: Liquor Depot Tampa
feeds.description: Liquor Depot all began 30 years ago and has continued to flourish in to the family owned and operated establishment it is today. Beginning with a single location, Frank Lawson began to build the business and acquire more locations. Up until two years ago, there were four different locations with a wide variety of names. (Liquor Depot / City Liquors / Pix Liquors / VIP Liquors) As the business and industry evolved it was time for Frank to either sell the business or offer an opportunity to his son, Trey.
